rustfang_medic.name: Rustfang Patcher

picture.note: Looks at the camera. The raised syringe is on the left of the picture, already toward the heroes. The bag hangs on the right hip.

rustfang_medic.note: Keeps the gang on its feet: take the medic down first or the fight drags on.
rustfang_medic.lore: The gang’s back-alley medic. Patches up bruisers with whatever’s in the bag.

rustfang_punk.name: Rustfang Punk

picture.note: Looks at the camera. The club is held out to the right of the picture, so it is mirrored to swing toward the heroes. The red logo on the vest is reversed.

rustfang_punk.lore: Rustfang muscle. Earns his colours one broken window at a time, and wears them in the rain so they run.

rustfang_slinger.name: Rustfang Slinger

picture.note: Looks at the camera. The lit bottle is held up on the left of the picture, already toward the heroes.

rustfang_slinger.lore: Hangs back and lobs whatever is on fire.

glowrat.name: Glowrat

picture.note: Side view: head and nose on the left, tail on the right.

glowrat.lore: Woken sewer rats. The glow is magic. The bite is worse.

scrap_hound.name: Scrap Hound

picture.note: Side view: head on the left, tail on the right.

scrap_hound.lore: Kessler-Mori perimeter hounds, auctioned off when the Annex closed. The buyers stopped feeding them. They never stopped guarding.

street_drone.name: Street Drone

picture.note: Hovers and looks at the camera. Rotors and eye are even on both sides.

street_drone.lore: A Saltreach PD patrol unit written off after the ’71 riots and never switched off. Still issuing citations to anything that moves.

smog_wisp.name: Smog Wisp

picture.note: Looks at the camera. The face is centred and the tendrils are even on both sides.

smog_wisp.lore: A spirit born of exhaust and neglect. Blades pass right through.

knuckles.name: “Knuckles” Tran

picture.note: Looks at the camera. A big fist on each side, so it reads the same both ways.

knuckles.lore: Rustfang enforcer. Named for his hands, both of which are chrome.

sewer_ghoul.name: Sewer Ghoul

picture.note: Hunched and turned to the right: the head sits right of the shoulders and the right claw reaches out. Mirrored so it reaches toward the heroes.

sewer_ghoul.note: Wounded ghouls frenzy. (The Sinkline enemies pay about 1.6x what they did: the floor has fewer random fights since the 2026-09-29 retune, and the Lurker's gear still has to be affordable from them.)
sewer_ghoul.lore: Infected people who went down into the dark and stayed.

rust_crab.name: Rust Crab

picture.note: Seen from the front: a claw up on each side and the legs even on both sides.

rust_crab.lore: Armored like a tank. Techs and magic get under the shell.

maint_drone.name: Maintenance Drone

picture.note: A tracked robot whose claw arm reaches out to the right of the picture, so it is mirrored to reach toward the heroes. The hazard stripes are reversed.

maint_drone.lore: Still fixing the tunnels. Views intruders as damage.

drowned_shade.name: Drowned Shade

picture.note: Looks at the camera. It holds a briefcase in its one visible hand, on the right of the picture, so it is mirrored to put the case toward the heroes.

drowned_shade.note: Shades wail together on a rhythm: every third round, expect it.
drowned_shade.lore: Echoes of commuters caught in the flood of ’61.

gutter_eel.name: Gutter Eel

picture.note: Side view: open jaws on the left, tail on the right.

gutter_eel.lore: Two meters of teeth and bioelectric spite.

lurker.name: The Lurker

picture.note: Side view: head and open mouth on the left, coils on the right.

lurker.note: Waterlogged: one clear weakness (shock), and the beast's usual fire weakness drowned out.
lurker.lore: Something Woke in the flooded junction and grew fat on what fell in.

km_sentinel.name: K-M Sentinel

picture.note: Looks at the camera, but the rifle points to the right of the picture, so it is mirrored to aim at the heroes. The K on the vest is reversed.

km_sentinel.note: Sentinels run a drill: a flashbang is likely every third round.
km_sentinel.lore: Kessler-Mori internal security. Their contracts forbid them to remember your face, and they are very good at their contracts.

sentry_turret.name: Sentry Turret

picture.note: The twin gun barrels and the red eye point left.

sentry_turret.lore: Ceiling-mounted autogun. When its barrels glow it is about to sweep the room: jam it, stun it, or brace.

km_arcanist.name: K-M Arcanist

picture.note: Turned a little to the left. The glowing orb is held up on the left of the picture, already toward the heroes.

km_arcanist.note: Hurt arcanists drain to stay alive.
km_arcanist.lore: Corporate thaumaturge. Every few breaths she pulls the building’s current through her visor; blind her, or hit her hard while she draws it, and it breaks apart.

hunter_drone.name: Hunter Drone

picture.note: Side view of a missile: the pointed nose and red eye are on the left, the engine on the right.

hunter_drone.lore: Paints a target, then erases it. Break the lock or scatter.

bound_spirit.name: Bound Spirit

picture.note: Looks at the camera. Arms up on both sides and a centred face.

bound_spirit.note: Softened for the 2026-09-29 retune: Sable's Crow Spirit, the crew's answer to spirits, now waits for a later chapter.
bound_spirit.lore: A spirit caged in a corporate ward. It hates everyone equally.

warden.name: WARDEN

picture.note: Looks at the camera, but the shoulder cannon points left (toward the heroes), so it stays as it is.

warden.lore: Annex 7 security platform. Its core runs on something that screams.

warden_spirit.name: Unbound Warden

picture.note: Looks at the camera. Arms up on both sides and a centred face.

warden_spirit.lore: The spirit K-M bound into the Warden’s core. Free, and furious.
